summary: RAG adapt: rewrite exemplar's 7 gold Qs one-to-one
hypothesis: Forcing the model to adapt each of the nearest exemplar's 7 concrete gold questions one-to-one to the new task should transfer the exemplar's full dimension span directly into the output, because the coverage gap is about which unknowns to probe — and hard-constraining the slots removes that judgment from the 3B entirely.
technique: RAG lookup of the nearest gold exemplar, then a single on-device generate call whose prompt treats that exemplar's 7 concrete gold questions as hard one-to-one rewrite constraints — the model must adapt each question to the new task while preserving the unknown it probes.
result: Scored 0.247 on dev-10 (0 wins / 0 ties / 10 losses vs Sonnet), falling −0.073 below the prior best exp003 (0.320) and −0.060 below baseline; discarded. Coverage stayed at 3 and non-redundancy dropped to 3 — the 3B anchored on surface wording and drifted, producing more duplicates than exp003 and still missing key dimensions, falsifying the hypothesis and closing the book on the entire RAG/prompt-injection family.
